outcome: Neonatal morbidity (meconium aspiration, respiratory distress, neonatal asphyxia)
cohort: 460 healthy pregnant women at a gestational age of 40-40+6 weeks who received antenatal care and delivered at King Chulalongkorn Memorial Hospital, Bangkok, Thailand, between July 2011 and March 2013.
finding: Routine NST at 40-40+6 weeks gestation provided no benefit to intrapartum or neonatal outcomes.
